final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), step2 AS (SELECT death_country, SUM(award_count) AS country_count FROM step1 GROUP BY death_country) SELECT step1.player_id, step1.death_country, step1.award_count, 1.0 * step1.award_count / step2.country_count FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step1.death_country = step2.death_country ORDER BY 1.0 * step1.award_count / step2.country_count DESC LIMIT 10
